source_text: Studeat unusquisque divisor effici aquae quae supra et quae subtus est, ut spiritalis aquae participium capiens flumina de ventre suo educat aquae vivae, segregatus ab aqua abyssi in qua tenebrae et princeps huius mundi habitant. Illius aquae supernae participio fidelis caelestis efficitur, nihil de terra sed totum de caelestibus cogitans.
pass_a_gloss: Let-strive each-one divider to-be-made of-water which above and which beneath is, that of-spiritual water share taking rivers from belly his he-may-lead-out of-water living, separated from water of-abyss in which darknesses and prince of-this world dwell. Of-that water upper by-share faithful heavenly is-made, nothing of earth but all of heavenly-things thinking.
pass_b_english: Let each of you strive to become a divider of the water above and the water beneath, so that, taking a share of spiritual water, you may bring [[rivers of living water from your belly >> Bible:John 7:38]], cut off from the water of the abyss where darkness and [[the prince of this world >> Bible:John 12:31]] dwell. By sharing that upper water the believer is made heavenly, thinking nothing of earth but all of the things above.
